# Act Build Change

> > Training the next generation of community organisers to build relational power and drive social justice through transformative organising.

Act Build Change provides courses, workshops, and resources for community organisers in the UK and beyond, focusing on power-building, collective care, and relationship-driven social change. The organization works with partners like POMOC, TreePeople, and Civic Power Fund to strengthen grassroots movements.

## Key Topics

- community organising
- relational power
- power-building
- transformative organising
- collective care
- relationship-building
- one-to-ones
- team-building
- social justice
- social change
- leadership development
- coaching
- workshops
- UK organising

## Core Training Courses

- [Introducing Community Organising](https://actbuildchange.com/courses/introducing-community-organising): Foundational course for aspiring community organisers
- [Introduction to Transformative Community Organising](https://actbuildchange.com/courses/introduction-to-transformative-community-organising): Beginner course on transformative organising and collective care
- [Rest](https://actbuildchange.com/courses/rest): Course on bringing rest practices to social justice work

## Workshops & Events

- [How to Build Relational Power in Community Organising Webinar](https://actbuildchange.com/events/how-to-build-relational-power-in-community-organising-webinar-aug-24): Webinar on relationship building with Shingai Mushayabasa
- [Building Leadership Teams Workshop](https://actbuildchange.com/events/building-leadership-teams-workshop): Workshop on building collective power through relationship-building
- [Practise Care to Navigate Tension - Community Organising Foundations](https://actbuildchange.com/events/collective-care-foundations-apr-2026): Training on collective care and team resilience with Ariel Whitson
- [First Launch of Funding Justice 3](https://actbuildchange.com/events/launch-of-funding-justice-3): Launch event for UK social justice grantmaking report
